authorization: W1-P2 Task 2 GO (assessment only) from Lead directive. NO production modifications, NO new Angular package, NO SSR remediation, NO test changes. Finish with a Wave 2 entry recommendation and smallest implementation slices.
nature: Read-only assessment. No source, package, SSR, or test changes. Grounded in real code citations.
decision: GO for a browser-only (CSR) thin Angular standalone adapter reusing @smilodon/core UNCHANGED. SSR deferred: minimum-viable = browser-deferred dynamic import + isPlatformBrowser guard + hydration-stable placeholder (no core change). API-075 remediation = separate, NOT AUTHORIZED follow-on.
coreFinding: The runtime is a browser custom element (<enhanced-select>) that owns ALL rendering/selection/keyboard/ARIA/data-loading. All adapters (React/Vue/Svelte/Vanilla) are thin imperative host bindings via the DOM contract. Selection authority is already engine-owned (W1-P2-T1 closed). An Angular adapter needs NO engine extraction/parity work.

capabilitiesVsComponent.integrationSurface: DOM custom element: imperative methods + CustomEvents (bubbles+composed). NOT the headless engine directly.

angularBoundaries.inputs: Map to updateConfig()/setItems()/setGroupedItems()/setSelectedValues()/setError()/setRequired(). MUST be method/property binding, NOT raw attributes (only aria-* observed).
angularBoundaries.outputs: Map element CustomEvents to @Output(): select, open, close, search, pageLoaded, error, change, loadMore, remove, clear, emptyStateChange, diagnostic.
angularBoundaries.lifecycle: ngAfterViewInit: await customElements.whenDefined('enhanced-select') (browser-only) -> configure -> attach listeners -> ngOnDestroy cleanup. Do NOT touch element/import core on server.
angularBoundaries.renderingOwnership: Element owns all rendering (shadow DOM). Angular only creates host + attribute/class/style binding + slot/renderer projection.

api075.observed: Package ENTRY import throws ReferenceError (HTMLElement is not defined) in no-DOM Node.
api075.rootCause: Components `extends HTMLElement` at class-declaration time + UNGUARDED top-level customElements.get('enhanced-select') at enhanced-select.ts:9107.

ssr.deeperBlocker: Even a guarded import does not fix server INSTANTIATION: EnhancedSelect constructor eagerly builds shadow DOM (attachShadow + _createContainer + _initializeObservers, enhanced-select.ts:512-572). Server-rendering the element fails regardless of import guarding.
ssr.strategyRecommended: Option A — defer element to browser: browser-only dynamic import('@smilodon/core'), isPlatformBrowser guard, hydration-stable placeholder. Needs NO core change.
ssr.strategyAlternative: Option B — SSR-safe core entry (corrects API-075) = PRODUCTION source change; NOT AUTHORIZED in T2; does not by itself fix constructor SSR.
ssr.ssrIsSeparateGate: ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md:61 and 179-SVELTE-MULTI-VERSION-DISTRIBUTION-ADR.md:29 list SSR/hydration as a separate, not-yet-passed gate.

designConstraints: observedAttributes = ['aria-label','aria-description','aria-busy'] ONLY (enhanced-select.ts:219). Behavior attributes are NOT observed; adapter must call updateConfig/setItems/etc.
Custom element upgrade timing: instance ready only after customElements.whenDefined; gate first setItems on readiness.
Existing Angular-specific workaround in connectedCallback: this.style.display='block' (comment 'for Angular compatibility'); review whether still needed; do NOT alter core in Wave 2.
